Polyanka is under attack!
Serdar!
Serdar?

Serdar! Wake up!

Serdar, Kuzmich, follow Sergey.

Use an explosive to blow it up.
Serdar, get ready! It's gonna get tough...
Sergey, come on, we have to go.
Seriously, Serdar, who sleeps during the day?
So everyone's a bit tense as you might imagine.
Sound the alarm!
To living!
Well guys, let's have a drink!
We're all that's left.
We're preparing a team to take them down.
What are you waiting for!?
What's up. Where is everyone!?
Yes...
Listen to me, Khan.
You're not a bad guy. But you keep to yourself too much.
Always sitting with your books - even talking you into getting a drink is tough...
Lighten up a bit, man!
You likely already heard the rumors,

Doctor.
Agh!
Serdar.
Aaaagh!
Die! Die! Die!
Agghh!
They ambushed us!
They go down quicker if you shoot their stomachs!

Nosalis! A damn horde!
Shoot them in the gut!
Shoot their stomachs!
They're coming for Polyanka!

That's not the part that worries me.
What if I am?
I'll be waiting for you at the barracks.
It's not a request. And we'll ensure your wife and kid are protected.
No!
We all are, Pyotr. Which is why we need you.
You're scared?
Doctor.
Nonsense. Nosalis don't hunt this far up the tunnels.
Okay, I've heard enough. How am I supposed to sleep tonight?
Heeeelp!

With a gun underneath your pillow.

I don't wanna die!
Good day.

To life!

Evgeniy!

No!
Shit!

No!
But they can't hold the south entrance!
We've got to do something!
The explosive, over there. Grab it.
They flanked us! The station is a bloodbath!
To life!
Wait!
Wait for us!
What are you waiting for!?
Where's the rest?
We took the women and children out through the side passages...
Yeah! Or you'll just end up all alone.
Be safe, Serdar.
But when the entire world gets immersed in the dark, you can’t avoid it any longer.
You can only embrace it.
And it will take all your courage and patience to keep looking.
Do we rely on our eyes too much?
Are we too convinced that the things we can see are real,
and those we can’t see are not?
What’s true darkness?
And what’s true blindness?
Open your eyes and you shall see.
It’s the unspeakable that scares us.
The unspeakable that the darkness holds within.
It’s the acid that corrodes the limits of the world we think we know.
Or you shall not?
Sometimes one must get into an utter darkness in order to begin to see.
We avoid the darkness because it hides things that may be too horrible for us even to imagine.
Déjà vu huh?
Isn’t that what they call it when you experience a memory from a past life?
He-llo?? Serdar?
Anybody in there??
If you say so...
Oh, I’m sorry. Of course...
Turn the key to start the trolley.
Are you ok? I've been yelling at you, but you just kept standing there,
staring off into space.
Vlad thought you were one of those bogeymen the Exhibition guys were babbling about.
Almost shot you!
I’ll be alright.
I'm fine.
I just had the strangest feeling of déjà vu for a moment.
Now if you don’t mind?
I’d like to get back home.
Past life?! Pfff!
It’s a misfiring of electrical discharges in your brain causing an illusion.
Nothing more.
Wha-what? I'm sorry, did you say something?
She obviously can't hear me.
Yana!
Dr. Iskanderov.
Sorry if you have to jump across the catwalk, but...
you can imagine who you have to thank for that one.
Do I really have to explain how to turn a handle to you??
Quite the mess your wife made, doc!
Climb down that ladder and help us clean it up, perhaps?
Great! There should be one more valve!
There might be a valve downstairs.
That's doing it.
Keep it up.
Unless we cut the pressure to these pipes,
one of these leaks is going to roast someone alive!
That's it! Thank you!
We have it under control now!
SERDAR. CLOSE THE VALVE!
What's with you?? Just shut the fucking valve!!
Shut it off already!
I gotta go. Max, out.
You want to switch jobs?
Maybe you should chase runaways and assholes all day,
and let me run around playing doctor for a while.
I've got a very healthy list of people I'd like to stab with a needle, let me tell you.
Don't even start.
You and your wife are not my favorite people right about now.
'Has something happened', he asks.
If by 'something', do you mean, 'did your wife destroy our mushroom farm
because she heard the voice of her dead son again'?
Because if so, then yes: something happened.
She's a lot better than our mushroom farm.
SHUT IT OFF, SHUT IT OFF!
CLOSE THE DAMN VALVE!
Five years to build this steam system.
Hundreds of issues to consider.
You know what scenario never came up?
'What if you can't hear the voices of the DEAD inside your pipes'!!
Yeah well, you've promised 500 times already.
I'm up to my eyeballs in bullshit today so I don't need any more, OK?!
Sorry. Go; go check on your wife.
But then, you come see me.
Friend or not, this station is my wife.
This has to be the end of it.
Great, a doctor who won't get his hand dirty.
That's a week's worth of water GONE, you know that??
I don't care if you boarded up every piss hole out of this place
with your own two hands, you check them again!
That girl had to go somewhere!
No. We’ve been over this.
Look, I don’t care!
Yeah yeah yeah... Sure.
Fine.
Right.
I've said no!
What?
Just do it!
Uh-huh.
Fuck! And there's more in there where that came from!
I don't understand - Yana was doing so well.
I'll take care of it. I promise.
Oh no... is she alright?
Yana?? Has something happened?
I think you may want to work on your bedside manner.
Hey Serdar!
Stick it to your shoulder, like this.
Voice-activated. State of the art, when there WAS a state of the art.
"It's almost like living in the future..."
And for times when my wisdom alone does not suffice...
The strong and silent type.
You want an empty clip just to look cool, be my guest.
Go on, smart guy - take it.
I doubt God invented plastic with nuclear winter in mind,
but, hey - a fake garden is better than no garden at all, eh?
How is Yana?
You know what? Good.
Say stupid shit more often; you two are so lovey dovey as it is,
I literally throw up in my desk at least once a day.
My friend, I've watched you both endure several lifetimes' worth of bullshit
just to try and make her feel halfway human again.
Trust me. Your wife knows that.
Eeeeh... you and bad timing, pal!
The stalker who tracks down your fancy medical stuff
-- very talented lady I used to run with named Nata --
she was supposed to make a delivery over a week ago.
Which is long enough that I think I may have to strike Nata out off
my little romantic birthdays calendar, if you know what I mean.
...though I do know the route she usually takes...
Well the goddamn Holy Grail 'COULD' be there...
Because you'll go!
And from here the first thing you'll hit is a nosalis den -
and that's probably the most relaxing part of the trip!
Oh, right. Your old station... sorry.
Um, anyway... normally I'd hire some poor suckers to go,
but since we're running low on poor suckers right now --
My lovely voice in your ear will have to do.
I'm the boss!
Are you sure you don't want to let Yana know you’re leaving?
Alright. Your call.
Hello?
I didn't hear a knock at the door.
Nope, still don't hear anyone knocking...
Yes, I know, very pretty.
Now do me a favor and holster it while you're in the station, OK cowboy?
We have to at least pretend we're civilized down here.
Lucky for you, the same supply cart that dropped 'Gorky Park' off here
is still out on the station.
And since nobody killed Akim on his way back here,
his spare ammo should still be on the trolley as well.
One sec--
Track 2. Call me when you find the ammo.
OK, I'm here. Let me find the ledger...
OK, go ahead.

Uh-huh. No.
Sure.
Give me a sec.

Get going?

I'm not asking you to go fight the Reds - it's for protection.
Don't pretend you're a pacificst.
I've seen you the way you eat.
Serdar, the radio.
Take it already, before I change my mind.
What's the matter? You don't like the color??
God, you're so picky.
Just take it.
Which is long enough that I think I may have to strike Nata out
off my little romantic birthdays calendar, if you know what I mean.
Could the medication still be there somewhere?
I've heard they don't do much without those bullets.
I’m sure.
Let us hope so.

run out of her Haloperidol.
That’s why she lost her edge.
Max. Why don't you just tell me where the route is?
Pretending her husband isn't a hot-headed, insensitive ass.
She was trying so hard to be reasonable...
You forget. I am not, shall we say, inexperienced when it comes to nosalis.
Max, you there?
I believe you called for a doctor?
The way this jungle is growing, we may never have to repopulate the surface.
You're a child.
You're empty, here's a new magazine.
Great.
I went through the trouble of draining a few bottles,
you know, give you something to shoot at.
Go on, get a feel for the trigger.
Line up your shots down the gun's sights.
It'll help your aim.
Not bad for a physician!
Now grab this magazine and store it.
Last thing you want is to run into some lurkers with an empty gun.
Show me that Tokarev Max gave you.
Insert that magazine into your Tokarev.
Take this magazine.
Next, grab this magazine and insert it into your Tokarev.
Hey - give yourself some credit.
The day is still young!
I don't know if you've handled that kind of trolley before,
but Akim was complaining it's hard to start.
Admittedly Akim is an idiot.
Serdar... Yana won’t like that you left without a word.
I've burdened my wife enough for one day, don't you think?
And you can't hear an eight-year old boy for fifteen years.
--BECAUSE HE DIED, YANA!!
'For all things, there is an explanation.'
Even the ones too terrible to accept.
...he died Yana, fifteen years ago.

Could you have overheard someone discussing it...?
Max said you heard Petya again.
Do you feel up to telling me about it?
My love is not something you ever have to apologize for.
It is free.
Perhaps.
We've been through this--.
WHERE'S THE SHUT-OFF??
--Yana, hallucinations are not--
--You hear voices no one else can --
--You threw them away???
You what?
Peek-a-boo.
So did I miss my calling as an interior decorator?
OK, go on then. I know you're dying to start doctoring me.
Do you, is the question...

Keep in mind I was still taking them when I decided to stop--
Please, Serdar! It hurt me!

they kept obscuring my ability to hear what I was so desperate to hear...
--What you assume are hallucinations--!
The fact that you won't even consider any alternative
is the reason I threw the Haloperidol out in the first place--!
--None of you have ever heard Petya's voice so how can you know what I'm hearing?!?
No, Mr. 'There-Has-To-Be-A-Reason-For-Everything',
I didn't hallucinate my son's voice because of a bunch of gossiping busybodies.
I can't exactly tell that to Petya, can I?
I'm sorry, that wasn't fair.
Not when you're only caring for me.
God, you're sappy.
Go on, run back to your boyfriend Max.
I heard him whining for you to go see him
once you made sure I wouldn't burn anything else down.
I think I've earned a little hard labor.
Just... give me some time, OK?
Hah, that did something... Looks like I can reduce some of the pressure from here.
I think there's a valve in the maintenance shaft
BACK THERE. THROUGH THE VENT!
Follow the pipe!
That did it.
Thank you for cleaning up another one of my messes.
Max passed through a while ago.
I guess you saw what happened at the farm then.
It's being taken care of.
Thanks.
Doctor! A drink!
On the house, for helping clear up that misunderstanding with Max!
Another time, perhaps.
I'm actually off to see him now.
It's not like somebody opened a hole in the ground and pushed her in.
Of course she ran off!
Besides, I'm pretty sure they're related.
Cousins or something.
They both disappeared around the same time.
I suppose.
But a girl that young...
you'd never have gotten me outside of a station on my own at that age.
Not a chance.
Do you really think Daria ran off with Andrey?
Are you kidding?! He's old enough to be her father!
Not to mention he looks like someone's armpit.
Nonsense. Andrey goes off every couple of months,
usually up to that whorehouse in Kitay-gorod from what I hear.
That wouldn't stop Andrey.
I thought I heard a nosalis.
But I heard they get in the walls.
Big ones, too.
But if there was...
somebody should be here.
To protect you and Lyuba.
Big nosalis in our beds.
Fedir's the man of the house now.
In these walls? Not a chance.
And besides, what safer place is there than home in your beds?
There's nothing out here, baby.
A few drunks, maybe, but certainly not a nosalis.
We protect each other.
That's why we're family.
Now move. Even nosalis need to sleep sometime.
Inside, both of you.
No, NO nosalis in our beds.
I thought I told you two to get inside.
It's past your bedtime.
Serdar - Max is back, he's up in the office.
Just head on in, he's expecting you.
Yes. He went to the farm to help with the repairs.
Grika, not Lerik.
But then Lerik said he saw Grika here in the market so I came to look for him.
Oh! Doctor!
Hi! You haven't seen my brother, have you?
Grika, not Lerik.
Uh, hello?? How rude!
I was only asking a question.
Ah, that would be great.
You see, I'd been planning to redo the family quarters today and Grika wanted to help.
Well, he didn't really WANT to help but he agreed to, because he knows momma
can't breathe in the back corner of the room because it gets really stuffy.
She's got this condition, but duh, you know that, you're her doctor!
Anyway, Grika was going to help last week but something came up,
and then this week he had to help Max put the caravan together to go to Riga.
I don't know if you noticed but Max really trusts Grika a lot!
He's almost never around anymore!
I tried to find him yesterday and I don't think he realized it was me because
he turned and walked around a corner, but when I found him,
he said we'd rearrange today for sure.
Only then Max needed him again, but if he's out here somewhere,
he must be done, right?
Otherwise he'd have come home.
Do you think I should be worried?
Anxious? I guess, if you say so, doctor.
Um, thanks?
I'll be sure to let him know if I see him.
Anna, I can see how distressing your brother's absence is.
Perhaps tomorrow, if you're still feeling anxious about...
this, you can come by and I'll prescribe something for your nerves.
Yes?
I have an--
I apologize, but I have--
Sorry, but I really--
I have an errand to--
You're looking for Grika?
God, I need a drink...
Well, let somebody else deal with this mess.
Arggh!
Hrng!
All that work, for what?
I am DONE.
Today's dish is meat and mushroom stew.
And no, I don't know which meat.
You've got to give him points for trying.
Did you see those Spartans that came through the other day?
What, like mercenaries?
More like showing off.
They'll probably march in here a few times a year,
give him a high five, and we're all supposed to feel safer at night.
I dunno.
For all the silly crap he trades for around here,
I'd be happy if we had a blanket that didn't smell like somebody died in it.
Get used to it.
Apparently, Max is trying to make some deal.
A "security resolution", he called it.
Hey.
Max, Serdar's here.
One sec--
Yeah yeah, send him in!
Good evening, Dr. Iskanderov.
Hello.
Oh good, he went that way.
Hey, Serdar.
Have you talked to Max yet?
I heard there's trouble at the mushroom farm.
No, I'm on my way to see him now.
Wow! They've got SO many different types of mushrooms here!
Everything's so NICE here!
And we're going to stay?
Like, for good?
I'm home now.
I told you you'd like Akademicheskaya.
That's right. Look around.
You're home now.
Fresh from the farm!
Come, feed your bellies!
Mushrooms! Get your mushrooms!
You won't find pre-war stock like this anywhere in the Metro!
We've got magazines!
Books! Some with all the pages!
Save yourself a trip to the tunnels!
We take the risk so you don't have to!
Best price for scrap, right here!
Good! SO much better.
I owe you, doc!
Happy to help. But no more rat kebabs for a while!
Ah, Radimil!
How's the stomach?
Oh hey Serdar.
Max isn't in his office.
If you go through the living quarters you might still catch him.
I can't even imagine.
How awful.
Did she leave a note or anything?
I heard all sorts of weird stuff happens out there.
What do you mean? Because of Daria?
Sad, but, you know, that's the Metro.
A friend of mine's entire family went missing a few months ago,
somewhere in one of the tunnels near Polyanka.
The search party found a knapsack and that was all.
No. Was just there one second and gone the next.
No. It's just getting late.
Let's just drop it.
There's a whole story to that place, but...
uh, maybe now's not the time.
So now he wants us to go around painting pink stripes on things?
I doubt it. Which probably means he wants new lights, too.
Yeah. Like hot pink.
Why?
I don't know. He said he still wasn't sure about the shade.
This is Max we're talking about.
Apparently he already did.
Did you know fuchsia is a color?
Max was debating painting stripes on the barricades
since people keep walking into them at night.
Are you kidding?? We just painted them!
And where's he even going to find pink paint??
The shade?
Does he really believe anyone will be able to tell the difference with these shitty lights?
That's what you said about monsters, too...
I don't like it!
I told you, I don't like it.
I want to have good food!
Like in Yasha's pictures!
What's there not to like?
I think it tastes pretty great!
Dominik, we told you.
Those old photos - you can't actually have those things anymore.
They are sort of like make believe.
Dominik, please. It's late.
Just eat your dinner before it gets cold, alright?
Do you think that food was free?
Everything just falls from the sky?
Eat your dinner, young man - that's an order!
We're here in Akademicheskaya.
Hansa leaves us alone.
The Reds leave us alone.
The Nazies leave us alone.
Even the mutants leave us alone, mostly.
Life's good, yes?
But consider this: it's 2028.
We survived a nuclear apocalypse and radiation
and all the shit life has thrown at us since.
But you tell me - where is everybody?
I don't mean Moscow or Russia.
I mean the WORLD!
We're down here, pissing all over each other's territory -
like a Metro station is the goddamned Winter Palace or something!
Even under the surface, it's not like we're hard to find!
But you're telling me not one plane survived on the entire planet?
No one's ever figured out how to contact a single satellite?
OR maybe --just maybe-- we're not even part of that world anymore.
What if the bombs didn't change the world...
they MOVED it to an alternate dimension?
Don't look at me like I'm crazy!
I'm telling you - open your feeble little minds
and really LISTEN to what I'm saying!
Hah, I look forward to seeing one of those first-hand someday.
Well Tasia, treating drunken merchants for radiation sickness rarely goes as planned.
He said to send you down to the mushroom farm as soon as you turned up.
And word of warning; our station chief is NOT in one of his better moods.
Thank God you're back.
Max has been up my butt asking where you are literally every 5 minutes.
You’ll know if it’s Nata’s.
She always brands her stuff with this fancyschmancy logo.
Big show off - all about the marketing.
I may have found something. Discarded supplies, debris.
Looks like a struggle occurred here.
Everything is "can't" with you!
I don't know what to tell you - that's where Nata's route runs.
The floor in the archives is collapsed.
I can't reach the stairwell.
Yes, I hear you my boy.
I am coming.
Petya, my sweet boy...
not a minute goes by that I don't think about you.
I should've never let go of your hand.
I miss you.
I miss you so, so much...
At a museum? You don't say.
Case solved, Sherlock!
Alright, Nata's route runs down the staircase on the opposite side of that room.
Could be just us, good old humans.
Metro's full of all sorts weirdos doing creepy shit.
I’ve heard all kind of tales on things that go beyond possible.
You know... Monsters whose existence you can’t explain.
One can see a rookie who’s venturing into Hell for the first time.
It’s Hell, stupid.
It just exists, and its rules change before you can understand them,
so that it can kill you and eat your soul.
Who the hell would do that??
I'm more interested in how they did it.
It's far too elaborate, even with a handful of men.
I quite like the “human” explanation.
It looked like a snake or something of that sort.
Have you heard of anything like that?
Now you’re talking souls.
Was it you, perchance, who stole Yana’s pills?
Oh come on.
Monsters are just those animals we humans haven’t studied properly yet.
There has to be an explanation.
Someone strung up a dead nosalis above the archives.
The nosalis had something painted across its chest.
I'd be fine with that, actually.
But hey, I guess there’s hardly anyone as different from Genghis Khan
as you in this universe.
Now you're just making stuff up!
Point taken. So what did you see?
When you were hypnotized?
What's funny?
What, was Peter The Great taken??
You actually did it?
You never told me this one!
Serdar-Khan! Oh, that’s hilarious.
Don't laugh. I told that story one too many times at my old station.
How would you like to forever be associated
with a man who murdered millions of people?
She became so enamored of the idea, she convinced me to undergo hypnotic regression.
As if I'd suddenly remember this entire past life she'd invented for me.
I couldn't remember anything really --
but Yana and the doctor assured me I was quite the convincing warlord.
The way Yana's mind worked...
It was intoxicating.
I never could keep up with that woman,
and that's what made her thoroughly irresistible.
This is all such cheap nonsense.
Past lives, afterlives, all alike.
That’s psychotherapy before psychotherapy:
allowing cavemen to cope with the fear of death, promising them a continuation.
